The x402 stablecoin protocol is gaining adoption .... 

As of the end of Q3 2026 over 138M x402 transactions had occurred on Base, the most popular blockchain for agentic commerce.

Over 87% of payments fall between a hundredth of a cent and a dime, with the most common size between one and ten cents. 88% of all AI model inference payments on x402 originated in the USA 

What is being paid for? >> AI model inference, games/gambling, code reviews, and market and financial analysis are all seeing traction. 

Lots more good stuff in the master report, see it here:  https://www.chainalysis.com/blog/north-america-crypto-adoption-2026/
